texts.label: text
texts.orig: A Share Option Incentive Plan has been established where employees of the consolidated entity with appropriate seniority and length of service have been issued with options over ordinary shares of Mermaid Marine Australia Limited.
texts.text: A Share Option Incentive Plan has been established where employees of the consolidated entity with appropriate seniority and length of service have been issued with options over ordinary shares of Mermaid Marine Australia Limited.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The options cannot be transferred and are not quoted on the ASX.
texts.text: The options cannot be transferred and are not quoted on the ASX.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: On 19 June 1999, 730,000 options were issued under this plan to employees. Since the date of issue 115,000 options have expired due to the non exercise of the options by employees who have since left Mermaid's employ. Of the remaining 615,000 ordinary shares under option pursuant to the Employee Option Plan, half (307,500) may be purchased within 12 months of 18 June 2000 at an issue price of 60 cents per share and half (307,500) may be purchased within 12 months of 18 June 2000 at an issue price of 70 cents per share.
